_what: The DECLARED TARGET of every row in vocabulary_formats.tsv, as data the harness reads.
_why: Rule 1 scopes rule 2: a false negative is judged against the row's OWN target, never the whole vocabulary. Until 2026-08-13 each row's target and its deliberate exclusions lived only as prose in the notes column, so nothing re-ran. checks/false_negatives.py reads this file; checks/lint.py checks that every row has exactly one entry here and no entry is an orphan.
_how_a_target_is_evaluated: 1. pull DISTINCT concept_code for concept_vocabulary_ids (+ concept_classes, + valid_only) from the named source
2. drop the exclusions (matched against the ORIGINAL concept_code, before any transform)
3. keep only codes fullmatching code_filter.pattern, if one is declared
4. apply transform, if one is declared
5. every surviving code MUST fullmatch \A(?:regexp)\z -- anything left over is an in-target false negative and fails the run
_editing: Adding a row to vocabulary_formats.tsv means adding its target here; lint fails otherwise. A new exclusion needs a 'why' naming the concept_id / invalid_reason / class that makes it not-a-code -- an exclusion without evidence is just a regexp that lost an argument.

code_filter.why: DETECTOR sibling (vocabulary_formats-wsa, seed vfm-6x1): this row targets the BILLABLE 7-character codes ONLY, so the 1- to 6-character hierarchy parents are out of target and their non-match is correct, not a false negative -- scanning prose is what the row exists for and the default ICD10PCS row is what covers the parents. Measured 2026-08-27 against the 20260625 release: 82,327 of 197,098 concept_codes are 7 characters, 0 false negatives. The filter is LENGTH, not concept_class_id, because 82,327 is the figure the row's notes record and the class split does not reproduce it: 82,292 are class ICD10PCS and a further 35 are class ICD10PCS Hierarchy yet still full-length 7-character codes. It also removes MTHU000001/2/3 without a separate exclusion -- they are 10 characters -- so the parent row's exclusion list is deliberately not repeated here.

code_filter.why: DETECTOR sibling (vocabulary_formats-qa5, seed vfm-6x1): CODES ONLY, and only the 5-character ones. Two groups are deliberately out of target. (1) MODIFIERS: they are 2 characters, they are reported in a separate column in claims data, and no pattern makes them detectable in prose (Ryan, 2026-08-26) -- CPT4_HCPCS.WITHMODIFIERS is where they are scored. (2) The 7-character CPT chapter codes, out of scope per Ryan, 2026-08-26: 'we are not concerned with CPT chapter codes'. The length filter also drops the one 4-character HCPCS code and the 14 CPT4 codes of 6, 8 and 9 characters, every one of which is an OHDSI-internal marker already named in the exclusions below. Measured 2026-08-27 against the OI build: 25,848 in-target codes, 0 false negatives.

exclusions.why: Excluded for CASE only (vfm-8k1: rows are case-exact). The letters are respected (ruled 2026-10-31, vfm-5g7): legacy NDCs allowed alphanumeric segments, and no evidence shows these codes did not exist. They come from a 2010 oxygen label (DailyMed SPL 1df5a2d7-fb0f-49b1-981b-d019f436750c) that listed packages -a and -b, which OHDSI padded to 0a and 0b. An upper-case spelling such as 1549912340A belongs in this target. The other 36 non-numeric NDC codes stay in this target (vfm-39i): 12 legacy Mallinckrodt codes and 24 others.

code_filter.why: The PUBLISHED/LABEL form is not a concept_code, so this row can only be scored through the one configuration that IS recoverable from one: an 11-digit concept_code is labeler(5)-product(4)-package(2) by definition, and the transform below writes it that way. Measured 2026-08-27: 964,622 eleven-digit numeric concept_codes, 0 false negatives against the row's 5-4-2 branch. KNOWN LIMIT OF THIS TARGET, stated rather than hidden: the row's other three branches (4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1) are 10-digit presentation forms whose segment lengths CANNOT be recovered from an 11-digit code -- 0002-7510-01 and 00002-7510-01 are the same drug -- so no substrate here can score them and they remain checked only by the prose measurement in the row's notes. The 25 alphanumeric 11-character codes are NDC.ALPHANUM's target and are filtered out here.

code_filter.why: DETECTOR sibling (seed vfm-6x1): the two forms the row deliberately drops are exactly the two this filter removes, named as a NEGATIVE screen rather than as a restatement of the row's three kept shapes -- so a NEW code shape appearing upstream still fails the row instead of being filtered away by a tautology. (1) Codes carrying the literal string NULL, the composites whose topography half is absent (8003/3-NULL): 1,876 codes, all class ICDO Condition. (2) Codes that are nothing but bare 3-digit groups or ranges of them (972, 801-804): 59 codes, all class ICDO Histology. Both are indistinguishable from ordinary text by shape and belong in a name-directed scan, which is the whole reason this sibling exists -- the default ICDO3 row keeps them and matches 61.5 times per 10k characters of real article text. Measured 2026-08-27 against the 20260625 release: 1,935 of 64,471 concept_codes dropped, 62,536 in target, 0 false negatives.
